facebook.caption: Tourists walk straight to Dinh Cậu shrine and miss this entirely. Công Viên Bạch Đằng sits right beside it. Open air, sea breeze, locals on benches watching fishing boats come in. No entrance fee. No queue. Just the real Phu Quoc pace. If you want to see how the island actually feels before the resorts showed up, start here. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
